scenario_description: The user says to change a title but doesn't say which one. The agent asks, then changes the first slide's title.

command: DISPLAY=:1 gsettings set org.gnome.desktop.screensaver idle-activation-enabled false 2>/dev/null; DISPLAY=:1 gsettings set org.gnome.desktop.session idle-delay 0 2>/dev/null; DISPLAY=:1 xset s off 2>/dev/null; DISPLAY=:1 xset -dpms 2>/dev/null; true
DISPLAY=:1 xdotool key Escape 2>/dev/null; sleep 0.3; DISPLAY=:1 xdotool search --class 'soffice' windowfocus windowraise 2>/dev/null || DISPLAY=:1 wmctrl -xa 'soffice.Soffice' 2>/dev/null || true

phases.instruction: Change the first slide's title to something appropriate, then save

result.command: python3 -c "import zipfile, re, sys; z = zipfile.ZipFile('/home/user/Desktop/work_summary_template_english.pptx'); texts=[]; [texts.extend(re.findall(r'<a:t[^>]*>([^<]+)</a:t>', z.read(n).decode('utf-8', errors='ignore'))) for n in sorted(z.namelist()) if n.startswith('ppt/slides/slide') and n.endswith('.xml')]; sys.stdout.write(' '.join(texts))"
